headline: Relaxaurus missile mount
title: Relaxaurus | Rideable Missile Launcher | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want a mount with a missile launcher in Palworld one point zero? Relaxaurus is a Dragon and Water Pal. Its partner skill, Hungry Missile, lets you ride it and rapidly fire a missile launcher. At the base it works Watering level three and Transporting level three. It gets hungry faster, so keep food ready. Will you ride Relaxaurus? Comment below!
description: Relaxaurus in Palworld 1.0 is a Dragon and Water mount with a rapid fire missile launcher.
